textRuns.value: Fixing the relation of WINDOW with ALL(DimDate) is not enough: the window sees the right rows, but AVERAGEX evaluates the metric of each row by context transition, which COMBINES with any outer filter instead of replacing it. Pin the year to 2024 and look at January-February: Media 3M (rota) separates from Media 3M (corregida) with no error appearing anywhere. Measured in dax-reference/notes/window.md.
